notes: Upgrades the hero buys for its own AI faction at its own Town Hall (useRange from the building edge).
Paid with the hero's gold. The effect is for the whole faction, right away, including units already alive.
requires lists what the AI faction must have for each level (building ids, see buildings.json notes).
Lists give one value per level.

upgrades.name: Better Arrows
upgrades.text: Ranged units and towers deal more damage.

upgrades.name: Stone Walls
upgrades.text: Buildings and towers get more health and armor.

upgrades.name: Rich Veins
upgrades.text: Workers bring more gold and wood each trip.

upgrades.name: War Banner
upgrades.text: Your army fights harder for 60 seconds: +15% damage, +10% move speed.

upgrades.name: Tier Up Fund
upgrades.text: Give 200 gold to your faction. It must be spent on the next Town Hall tier.
upgrades.disabledWhen: Town Hall is already a Citadel
